dataset.title: Butterflies-Austria-20
dataset.author: Christian Menard
dataset.data_distribution: This repository contains manifests and experimental metadata, not the image dataset. Dataset terms and image rights are governed by the dataset publisher.

path_convention: relative_path is relative to the dataset root; sample_id is relative to its split directory. Paths use forward slashes.
class_index_convention: Zero-based index in lexicographically sorted class directory names, matching ImageFolder.
sample_order: Within each split, classes and image paths are sorted lexicographically. split_index is zero-based.

partition.procedure: Sort classes and source image paths; sklearn.model_selection.train_test_split separates a stratified 20% remainder, then divides that remainder equally into val and test with random_state=42 in both calls.
partition.reproduction_authority: The per-image split manifests define exact membership; a new random split does not replace them.

initial_export.per_image_selection_record: The initial-export notebooks did not persist the selected image paths. This protocol is recorded from their code; calibration_stratified_1000.csv describes a different calibration experiment.

structural_comparison.ordering: Recorded experiment order, not a new random selection.

preprocessing.evaluation: Validation, test, and calibration use deterministic model-specific preprocessing without random augmentation.
